description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mailawalana, Dompe D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511000
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including details of land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and property encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land registration and title settlement processes, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
